LESSON: MSAMIATI

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.14: Msamiati

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo ni somo la kusoma: Msamiati. Soma maelezo, fuata mifano iliyofanyiwa kazi, kisha fanya mazoezi.

SEHEMU 2: MALENGO

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. explain what Msamiati means in simple pupil language
2. give 3 correct examples of Msamiati from Kenya
3. practise Msamiati in clear steps
4. apply Msamiati in one real-life situation this week

SEHEMU 3: SOMO (MAELEZO NA MIFANO)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: MSAMIATI
Subject: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES · Grade: Grade 1
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Msamiati helps you succeed in KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES. You will understand it, practise it, and use it nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

KEY FACTS: MSAMIATI
Study Msamiati like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Explain what Msamiati means in simple pupil language

What this means
In this part you learn to explain what Msamiati means in simple pupil language. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain what Msamiati means in simple pupil language.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kusoma: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “Msamiati”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain what Msamiati means in simple pupil language. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Give 3 correct examples of Msamiati from Kenya

What this means
In this part you learn to give 3 correct examples of Msamiati from Kenya. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: give 3 correct examples of Msamiati from Kenya.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kuzungumza: Zungumza na rafiki kwa dakika 1 kuhusu Msamiati.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can give 3 correct examples of Msamiati from Kenya. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Practise Msamiati in clear steps

What this means
In this part you learn to practise Msamiati in clear steps. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: practise Msamiati in clear steps.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kuandika: Andika sentensi 3 sahihi kuhusu Msamiati.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can practise Msamiati in clear steps. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 4: Apply Msamiati in one real-life situation this week

What this means
In this part you learn to apply Msamiati in one real-life situation this week. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: apply Msamiati in one real-life situation this week.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kusoma: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “Msamiati”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can apply Msamiati in one real-life situation this week. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Msamiati is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO YA HARAKA

Example 1: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “Msamiati”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako. (skill: explain what Msamiati means in simple pupil language)

Example 2: Zungumza na rafiki kwa dakika 1 kuhusu Msamiati. (skill: give 3 correct examples of Msamiati from Kenya)

Example 3: Andika sentensi 3 sahihi kuhusu Msamiati. (skill: practise Msamiati in clear steps)

Example 4: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “Msamiati”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako. (skill: apply Msamiati in one real-life situation this week)

SEHEMU 5: MAZOEZI

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Msamiati to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: explain what Msamiati means in simple pupil language.
3. Practise this skill: give 3 correct examples of Msamiati from Kenya.
4. Practise this skill: practise Msamiati in clear steps.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Msamiati from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA NYUMBANI

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Msamiati: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 1 learner study Msamiati?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. Know what Msamiati means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: explain what Msamiati means in simple pupil language.
5. Be able to: give 3 correct examples of Msamiati from Kenya.

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
